notes: Short warm 1:1 note from a past client thanking Ryan and casually mentioning they told a friend about him. No property, no criteria, no listing. Tests that pure relationship maintenance is CLIENT_CONVERSATION and not mistaken for a SELLER_LEAD/BUYER_ISO just because a 'friend looking' is name-dropped without any actionable detail.

input.subject: Thank you (and a hello)
input.bodyText:
Hi Ryan,

Just wanted to say the housewarming was lovely and we're finally unpacked. You made the whole thing so painless - we still can't believe how fast it all came together.

Oh - I was telling my coworker Aisha about you over lunch. She and her partner might start looking next spring, nothing serious yet, but I gave her your number. Hope that's okay!

We owe you a dinner. Thank you for everything.

Warmly,
Marisol
